title: Conformance harness: XCTest runner over vendored vectors + CI wiring
description: Add the mechanical conformance gate that runs all vendored vectors against the ported functions.
design: WPSyncConformanceTests.m loads index.json + each *.vectors.json (vendored by B_PKG), maps Infinity/-Infinity/NaN string sentinels <-> doubles, calls each port function with input, asserts deep equality (relative epsilon 1e-6 for computeBackoffSleep). Wire into the test scheme so vector drift fails CI.
acceptance_criteria: All 10 functions vector files pass in CI.

title: Port contact single-object store (WPSyncContactStore)
description: Port the single-object replace/patch/clear semantics used by the contact source.
design: sync-contact-store.ts:31-52 applyContactData (full replace, deep copy), applyContactDelta (deep-merge with null-field-removes), clearContact (nil). Reuse WPJsonUtil merge:with:nullFieldRemoves:YES (WPJsonUtil.h:23).
acceptance_criteria: Passes contact-store.vectors.json (6).

title: Port classifyResponse + processSourceBlock (WPSyncProcessor)
description: Port the path/method classifier and the core response decision function.
design: sync-processor.ts:88-110 classifyResponse (opportunistic POST /events & PATCH /installation; explicit GET /contact|/user|/installation|/popups|/inbox; else none) and :133-265 processSourceBlock (7 branches: missing, empty {}, meta-only, payload acceptance via acceptsResponse, no-payload version mismatch, degenerate readDate-only, head hints) returning a ProcessorDecision (newState/clearState/applyData/applyDelta/triggerFetch weak|firm/fetchHint). Pure, no IO.
acceptance_criteria: Passes classify-response (7) and process-source-block (15) by deep equality of decision incl newState.

title: Port DEFAULT_KNOBS + mergeKnobs + isStateStale (WPSyncKnobs)
description: Port default knobs, remote-config merge, and the max-age staleness predicate.
design: sync-knobs.ts:29-56 DEFAULT_KNOBS; :80-98 mergeKnobs (sync* remote keys, per-field numeric validation w/ fallback, kill-switch syncOpportunisticInjection where only explicit false disables); :117-125 isStateStale. Map Infinity/-Infinity/NaN string sentinels to doubles.
acceptance_criteria: Passes merge-knobs (6), is-state-stale (4), and default-knobs.json exactly.

title: Port fetch-policy pure helpers (WPSyncFetchPolicy)
description: Port the debounce, rate-limit, backoff, and explicit-fetch param builder.
design: sync-fetch.ts shouldDebounceWeakSignal(:44-50), shouldRateLimitSource(:61-67, applies to ALL triggers, 0 disables), computeBackoffSleep(:79-84 MIN(MAX, MIN*RATIO^count)*(1+rand*JITTER), 0 for count<=0), buildExplicitFetchParams + SOURCE_TO_EXPLICIT_PATH.
acceptance_criteria: Passes compute-backoff-sleep (7, epsilon 1e-6), should-debounce-weak-signal (5), should-rate-limit-source (7).

title: Port compareVersionId + acceptsResponse (WPSyncVersionId)
description: Port the VersionId total order and the response acceptance check.
design: sync-versionid.ts:22-48 compareVersionId (null < int64 < string; natural numeric; lexicographic UTF-8 byte-wise for strings) and :80-96 acceptsResponse (monotonic version/versionId/readDate OR empty-reset version==0 and data {} or [] and readDate newer). WPSyncVersionId.{h,m}.
acceptance_criteria: Passes compare-version-id.vectors.json (81) and accepts-response.vectors.json (9).
notes: DONE. WPSyncVersionId.{h,m} (leaf-level, Foundation-only, mirrors JS sync-versionid.ts no-imports): +compareVersionId:with: -> NSComparisonResult (-1/0/1; null/NSNull < int64 < string; numeric natural; strings byte-wise UTF-8 via strcmp on UTF8String) and +acceptsResponseWithVersion:versionId:readDate:data:lastVersion:lastVersionId:lastReadDate: (monotonic + empty-reset branches, primitives to stay leaf-level). Wired into WonderPush.xcodeproj (framework Sources/Headers) + WPSyncVersionIdTests.m into WonderPushExampleTests. Ran on iPhone 17 Pro sim: 8 VersionId tests pass (+12 Types still green) = 20, TEST SUCCEEDED. Full 81+9 vector run deferred to harness .11.
close_reason: compareVersionId + acceptsResponse implemented, wired, 8 XCTest cases pass on simulator.

title: Sync core types: WPSyncSourceState, WPSyncKnobs, WPSyncResponseBlock, WPSyncDecision
description: Port the core data structures shared by all pure-logic functions.
design: From sync-state.ts:10-31 (SyncSourceState: lastSyncDate,lastSyncMeta,lastVersion,lastVersionId,lastReadDate,lastFetchAttemptedDate,lastFetchUnsuccessfulAttemptCount,data + emptyState), sync-knobs.ts:9-27 (SyncKnobs 11 fields), sync-processor.ts:13-23 (ResponseBlock) and :36-47 (ProcessorDecision incl FetchHint). ObjC model objects or typed dictionary wrappers over Foundation; VersionId = NSNumber|NSString|NSNull.
acceptance_criteria: Types compile; emptyState equals JS zeros/nulls.
notes:
DONE. Created 4 ObjC type pairs in Sources/WonderPush: WPSyncSourceState (+emptyState/stateWithDictionary/toDictionary/isEqual/NSCopying), WPSyncKnobs (struct + knobsWithDictionary/toDictionary; DEFAULT_KNOBS+merge live in .7), WPSyncResponseBlock (presence-aware accessors: nil=absent vs NSNull=explicit null; isEmpty for the {} signal), WPSyncDecision + WPSyncFetchHint (toDictionary omits unset fields). NOTE for .9: the decision's persisted-state property is named 'nextState' (not 'newState') to avoid ARC's new-prefix ownership rule; it still serializes under JSON key 'newState'. VersionId carried as id (NSNumber|NSString|nil). Verified: compiles -Wall clean + 32 assertions (emptyState zeros/nulls, round-trips, Infinity, presence distinctions) via standalone clang/Foundation run.
Unit tests added: WonderPushExampleTests/WPSyncTypesTests.m (12 XCTest cases). Wired the 4 source pairs into WonderPush.xcodeproj (WonderPush framework target: Sources +4, Headers +4 as project headers like WPRemoteConfig.h) and the test file into the WonderPushExampleTests target (+1). Ran: xcodebuild test -project WonderPush.xcodeproj -scheme WonderPushExampleTests -destination 'iOS Simulator,iPhone 17 Pro' -only-testing:WonderPushExampleTests/WPSyncTypesTests -> 12 passed, 0 failures, TEST SUCCEEDED (built real framework, 104 sources). The throwaway clang harness was replaced by these committed tests.
close_reason: Types implemented, compile clean, emptyState matches JS; verified by standalone clang run (32 assertions).

title: Decision: which iOS request path carries POST /v1/events and PATCH /v1/installation
description: Identify the exact client(s)/methods to hook for outgoing injection and incoming interception so the server algorithm actually receives sync params.
design: JS injects _syncUserId/_syncDeviceId/_syncInstallationId/_syncVisitorId + _SOURCESync.* on POST /events and PATCH /installation, and intercepts those responses plus _serverTime. iOS candidates: events via WPMeasurementsApiClient (measurements-api.wonderpush.com) and/or WPAPIClient (WonderPushConcreteAPI.m:160-167); PATCH /installation via WPJsonSyncInstallation.m:263-285 -> WonderPush.requestForUser. Injection point: WPBaseAPIClient.decorateRequestParams (WPAPIClient.m:132). Interception point: WPRequest.handler / WPBaseAPIClient.executeRequest.
acceptance_criteria: Confirmed list of client+method hook points for both endpoints, both directions.
notes: RESOLVED. Findings: POST /events is sent by (a) trackEvent path -> WPAPIClient/WPAnonymousAPIClient (WonderPushConcreteAPI.m:247,259) and (b) countEvent path -> WPMeasurementsApiClient (WonderPushConcreteAPI.m:166). PATCH /installation -> WPAPIClient via WonderPush.requestForUser (from WPJsonSyncInstallation.m). DECISION: cover BOTH carriers in v1. Main+anonymous path hooks centrally in WPBaseAPIClient (decorateRequestParams WPAPIClient.m:131 outgoing; executeRequest success handler parsing responseJSON incoming). Measurements path is a different lineage (WPBasicApiClient) decorating a body STRING (WPMeasurementsApiClient.m:32 decorateRequestBody:userId:) -> separate injection + response parse, tracked as its own issue.
close_reason: Decided: hook WPBaseAPIClient (main+anon) AND WPMeasurementsApiClient (body-string) in v1.

title: Decision: implementation language Objective-C vs Swift for sync module
description: Choose the language for the new sync module. Recommendation: Objective-C.
design: Recommend ObjC: SDK is ~98% ObjC; zero-bridging reuse of WPJsonUtil (merge/diff/nullFieldRemoves), WPConfiguration+NSUserDefaults, WPAPIClient, WPRequest; matches WPJsonSync/WPJsonSyncInstallation precedent. VersionId maps to NSNumber|NSString|NSNull. Swift would be cleaner for pure logic but the glue lives in ObjC and would need ObjC<->Swift bridging. Conformance vectors load via NSJSONSerialization in XCTest.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded decision; default ObjC unless the human rejects.
notes: RESOLVED: Objective-C. SDK is ~98% ObjC; zero-bridging reuse of WPJsonUtil (merge/diff/nullFieldRemoves), WPConfiguration+NSUserDefaults, WPAPIClient, WPRequest; matches WPJsonSync/WPJsonSyncInstallation precedent. All WPSync* files are ObjC under Sources/WonderPush. VersionId = NSNumber|NSString|NSNull; conformance vectors load via NSJSONSerialization in XCTest.
close_reason: Decided: Objective-C (matches existing SDK; no bridging).

title: iOS SDK sync channel - port sdk-sync from JS reference
description: Port the Brevo sdk-sync SDK-side channel (spec: sdk-sync/docs/docs/sync/algorithm.md) from the JS reference SDK (wonderpush-javascript-sdk, src/wonderpush/sync-*) into the WonderPush iOS SDK. Pure logic is pinned by vendored conformance vectors; glue is platform-specific. Roll out per source: contact (pilot), then user/installation, then popups/inbox.
design: JS module -> iOS file mapping (new WPSync* files under Sources/WonderPush, ObjC, matching WPJsonSync precedent): sync-versionid.ts->WPSyncVersionId; sync-processor.ts->WPSyncProcessor; sync-fetch.ts->WPSyncFetchPolicy/WPSyncFetcher; sync-knobs.ts->WPSyncKnobs; sync-state.ts->WPSyncSourceState/WPSyncStateStore; sync-contact-store.ts->WPSyncContactStore; sync-outgoing.ts->WPSyncOutgoing; sync-incoming-wrap.ts->response interceptor in WPBaseAPIClient; sync.js->WPSync orchestrator; sync-contact.js->WPSyncContactSource.
acceptance_criteria: All conformance vectors pass in CI; contact source synced end-to-end on device; remaining sources tracked as children.

title: Measurements API sync injection + interception (body-string carrier)
description: Cover the WPMeasurementsApiClient carrier for POST /events (countEvent / notification-receipt path) for both outgoing injection and incoming interception, in addition to the main WPBaseAPIClient path.
design: WPMeasurementsApiClient is WPBasicApiClient lineage and decorates a body STRING via decorateRequestBody:userId: (WPMeasurementsApiClient.m:32), unlike WPBaseAPIClient which decorates a params dict. Add: (1) outgoing injection of _sync* identifiers + _SOURCESync.* onto the measurements request (per buildOutgoingParams from WPSyncOutgoing), adapted to this client's encoding; (2) incoming interception of the measurements response to read _serverTime + _SOURCESync and feed WPSyncProcessor. Reuse WPSyncOutgoing/WPSync orchestrator; only the client-specific encode/parse differs. Per resolved decision i2x.2.
acceptance_criteria: countEvent-path POST /events carries sync params and its response updates sync state, equivalently to the main client path.

title: Contact pilot integration tests
description: End-to-end tests for the contact source on iOS.
design: XCTest covering: opportunistic injection on POST /events and PATCH /installation; explicit GET /contact; out-of-order/stale responses ignored; identifier-change reset; offline + backoff via WPRequestVault. Use fixture JSON like WonderPushExampleTests/remote-config-example.json.
acceptance_criteria: Green integration suite for contact.

title: WPSync orchestrator singleton + lifecycle
description: Tie the glue together behind a single coordinator with source registration.
design: Port sync.js: registerSource(name,plugin), identifiers(), prepareOutgoingParams, consumeIncomingResponse, fetch(source), checkMaxAgeForcing after each response. Initialize on SDK init; track current profile via WPConfiguration userId/deviceId/installationId; handle identifier-change reset (reset to empty + refetch within the same profile slot).
acceptance_criteria: Sources register; opportunistic + explicit + max-age forcing wired end-to-end.

title: Contact source plugin + public read API (WPSyncContactSource)
description: Wire the contact source and expose its data for popup segmentation.
design: Port sync-contact.js: register 'contact' with applyData/applyDelta/clearState backed by WPSyncContactStore. Expose an SDK read accessor for contact data so local popup segmentation can use it.
acceptance_criteria: Contact data syncs and is readable; survives relaunch and user switch.

title: Per-source mutex + processing serialization
description: Serialize fetches and response processing per source on a single process.
design: JS uses named cross-tab mutexes with TTL (sync:SOURCE and sync:proc:SOURCE). iOS single-process: per-source serial dispatch queue or NSLock + in-flight guard for both fetch and load->process->save cycles. Crash-safety across launches via persisted lastFetchAttemptedDate rather than TTL.
acceptance_criteria: No interleaving of process cycles; no parallel fetch per source.

title: Explicit fetch scheduling + backoff (WPSyncFetcher)
description: Implement the explicit GET fetch loop with backoff, debounce, and rate-limit.
design: GET /contact|/user|/installation|/popups|/inbox via WPAPIClient. Port sync.js fetch loop (algorithm.md:245-257): weak-signal debounce, per-source rate-limit floor (all triggers), acquire mutex, stamp lastFetchAttemptedDate, increment fail count, backoff sleep via dispatch_after, on success reset count + process response, on failure leave count, release mutex.
acceptance_criteria: Backoff/retry/rate-limit honored; single in-flight fetch per source.

title: Outgoing param injection (WPSyncOutgoing) + request-build hook
description: Inject identifiers and per-source sync cursor onto opportunistic requests.
design: Port sync-outgoing.ts buildOutgoingParams + shouldInjectForPath. Add _syncUserId/_syncDeviceId/_syncInstallationId/_syncVisitorId and _SOURCESync.{lastSyncDate,lastSyncMeta(JSON),lastVersion,lastVersionId,lastReadDate} on POST /events and PATCH /installation; omit null fields. Hook at the path determined by D2 (e.g. WPBaseAPIClient.decorateRequestParams). Gate on opportunisticInjectionEnabled.
acceptance_criteria: Both endpoints carry correct params; disabled when kill-switch off.
notes: Scope per i2x.2: this issue covers the main+anonymous WPBaseAPIClient path; the WPMeasurementsApiClient body-string path is handled in wonderpush-ios-sdk-i2x.25.

title: Incoming response interceptor -> processor
description: Intercept API responses and feed sync blocks to the processor.
design: Port sync-incoming-wrap.ts behavior. Wrap response handling in WPBaseAPIClient.executeRequest / WPRequest.handler to read _serverTime and _SOURCESync (opportunistic) or top-level fields (explicit), classifyResponse, run processSourceBlock, persist newState, run plugin callbacks (applyData/applyDelta/clearState), then trigger fetch + checkMaxAgeForcing. Fire-and-forget; never block the original handler.
acceptance_criteria: Opportunistic and explicit responses update state and fire follow-up fetches correctly.
notes: Scope per i2x.2: this issue covers the main+anonymous WPBaseAPIClient path; the WPMeasurementsApiClient response parse is handled in wonderpush-ios-sdk-i2x.25.

title: Wire sync knobs from WPRemoteConfig
description: Feed remote-config overrides into the knobs at runtime.
design: On WPRemoteConfig update, read sync* keys from WPRemoteConfig.data and run mergeKnobs over DEFAULT_KNOBS; honor the opportunisticInjection kill-switch; fall back to defaults when absent. WPRemoteConfig.{h,m}.
acceptance_criteria: Knobs reflect remote config; defaults used when keys absent; kill-switch disables injection.

title: WPSyncStateStore persistence (NSUserDefaults, per source x profile)
description: Persist per-source per-profile sync state across launches and user switches.
design: Port sync-state.ts SyncState + storageKey scoped by (source,userId,deviceId). iOS: new WPConfiguration key e.g. __wonderpush_syncStatePerSourcePerUserId, JSON serialized like WPJsonSyncInstallation.m:214-220. load/save/emptyState; retain non-current profile slots so switching back avoids refetch; deviceId from WPConfiguration.deviceId.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip persistence test; profile switch retains and restores slots.

title: Decision: multi-object (popups/inbox) local store, merge and entry caps model
description: Decide list storage shape and merge implementation for multi-object sources before implementing them.
design: Multi-object sources store a single server-merged list (never split per identifier), apply delta (array of full objects), cap by maxPopupsEntries/maxInboxEntries, order by updateDate desc then id, and accept device-targeted duplication across profiles (algorithm.md:35-51, 136-143, 312-324). Decide NSUserDefaults JSON list shape and dedupe/merge utility. May be deferred.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded decision covering storage shape, merge, caps, ordering.
notes: RESOLVED (deferrable design). Store one JSON array per (source, profile) in a new WPConfiguration NSUserDefaults key (e.g. __wonderpush_syncListPerSourcePerUserId). Apply delta as array of full objects keyed by id; cap at maxPopupsEntries/maxInboxEntries; order by updateDate desc then id desc (compareVersionId); keep soft-delete tombstones until expiration and filter them on read. Single server-merged list only; never split per identifier; accept device-targeted duplication across profiles. Implemented in S_POP/S_INBOX.
close_reason: Decided: single capped JSON array per source/profile in NSUserDefaults; delta-by-id; tombstones filtered on read.

title: Add WPSync* sources to podspec + Package.swift + vendor conformance vectors
description: Wire new files into both build systems and vendor the conformance vector JSON as test resources.
design: WonderPush.podspec.json source_files glob Sources/WonderPush/*.{m,h} already covers new files; verify SPM WonderPushObjC target includes them; expose any public read API in public_header_files. Vendor the 11 JSON files from sdk-sync/docs/docs/sync/sdk-conformance into the repo (pinned to a spec revision) as a test resource bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Builds via CocoaPods and SPM; XCTest can load vendored vector resources.
notes: Xcode-project wiring (separate from podspec/SPM): WonderPush.xcodeproj uses EXPLICIT file references (no Xcode-16 synchronized folder groups), so every new WPSync*.{h,m} must be added to the WonderPush framework target's Sources (.m) and Headers (.h, project scope) build phases, and each test file to the WonderPushExampleTests target's Sources. CAVEAT: the python 'pbxproj' lib's save() is broken on this setup (truncates the file on a serialization bug) - do NOT use it to write. Use targeted text insertions anchored on existing WPRemoteConfig entries, then validate with 'plutil -lint' + a pbxproj load. The pod 'source_files' glob (Sources/WonderPush/*.{m,h}) and the SPM target path already auto-include new files, so only the .xcodeproj needs manual wiring.

title: Inbox multi-object source + read/unread/delete sync-back
description: Add the inbox list source with status mutations synced back to the server.
design: Multi-object store (per D3) for source 'inbox', cap maxInboxEntries. Expose retrieve/markRead/markUnread/delete; push status changes server-side and reconcile via sync. Soft-delete tombstones until expiration; identifiers contact/user/installation/device/visitor.
acceptance_criteria: Inbox messages synced; status changes propagate across devices.

title: Installation source (single-object; guard SDK-owned fields)
description: Add the installation object source, taking care with fields the SDK itself writes.
design: Single-object store for source 'installation'. Caution: most fields are already SDK-known and SDK-written via WPJsonSyncInstallation; only adopt server-side changes for non-SDK-owned fields to avoid clobbering local pending writes (algorithm.md goals section). Identifier: installationId.
acceptance_criteria: Server-side installation changes picked up without clobbering SDK-pending custom props.

title: Popups multi-object source
description: Add the popups list source and merge it with remote-config in-app campaigns.
design: Multi-object store (per D3): single server-merged list, delta of full objects, cap maxPopupsEntries, order updateDate desc/id; merge ported popup rules with remote-config inAppConfig.campaigns; identifiers contact/user/installation/device/visitor.
acceptance_criteria: Targeted popups synced and merged with remote config; caps respected.

title: User source (single-object)
description: Add the user object source (single-object semantics).
design: Reuse single-object store pattern (like contact) for source 'user'; register plugin; expose read accessor for segmentation. Identifier: userId.
acceptance_criteria: User data synced and readable; conformance unaffected.
